words.gloss: who has carried out instigation (of the enemy's men)
who has made provision against the season

hindi: जो बल में श्रेष्ठ हो, जिसने शत्रु-पक्ष में उपजाप कर लिया हो और जिसने ऋतु के विरुद्ध प्रतिविधान कर लिया हो, वह अपनी भूमि पर प्रकाश-युद्ध करे।
english: One who is superior in strength, who has carried out instigation (of the enemy's men), and who has made provision against the season, should resort to open battle on his own ground.
notes: upajāpa = secret instigation / sowing dissension among the enemy's people; prakāśa-yuddha = open (declared) battle, contrasted with kūṭa-yuddha in the next unit.

hindi: विपरीत स्थिति में कूट-युद्ध करे।
english: In the opposite case, (he should resort to) deceptive battle.
notes: upeyāt is carried over from unit 1.

words.gloss: at times of calamity to the (enemy's) troops or of a surprise attack
himself standing on his own ground
having a hold over the (enemy's) constituent elements
(the enemy) standing on his own ground

hindi: सेना पर विपत्ति आने या आकस्मिक आक्रमण के अवसरों पर शत्रु पर प्रहार करे; अथवा स्वयं अपनी भूमि पर स्थित होकर प्रतिकूल भूमि पर स्थित शत्रु पर; अथवा शत्रु की प्रकृतियों पर पकड़ रखते हुए अपनी भूमि पर स्थित शत्रु पर भी प्रहार करे।
english: He should strike the enemy at times of calamity to the (enemy's) troops or of a surprise attack; or, himself standing on his own ground, (strike) the enemy standing on unfavourable ground; or, having a hold over the (enemy's) constituent elements, (strike) the enemy even when standing on his own ground.
notes: prakṛti-pragraha is ambiguous: 'having a hold over (won over) the enemy's constituents' or 'having the support of his own constituents'; the first is given. bala-vyasana may also mean 'calamity (weakness) of the army' generally.

words.gloss: with troops of the treasonable, of enemies and of forest tribes
(the enemy) who has reached unfavourable ground

hindi: अथवा दूष्य, अमित्र और अटवी की सेनाओं से भंग दिखाकर प्रतिकूल भूमि में पहुँचे हुए शत्रु पर प्रहार करे।
english: Or, having given a (feigned) rout with troops of the treasonable, of enemies and of forest tribes, he should strike (the enemy) when he has reached unfavourable ground.
notes: bhaṅgaṃ dattvā = 'giving way', i.e. feigning a rout to draw the enemy on.

hindi: संहत शत्रु-सेना को हाथियों से तोड़ दे।
english: He should break up a compact (enemy) army with elephants.

hindi: पहले भंग दिखाकर, पीछा करते हुए बिखरे और टूटे हुए शत्रु पर स्वयं अटूट रहकर लौटकर प्रहार करे।
english: Having first given a (feigned) rout, he, himself unbroken, should turn back and strike (the enemy) who has scattered in pursuit and is broken (in formation).
notes: anupralīna taken as 'dispersed while following (in pursuit)'.

hindi: सामने से प्रहार करके, डगमगाते या मुँह फेरते शत्रु पर पीछे से हाथियों और घोड़ों से प्रहार करे।
english: Having struck from the front, he should strike (the enemy), wavering or turned away, from the rear with elephants and horses.

hindi: पीछे से प्रहार करके, डगमगाते या मुँह फेरते शत्रु पर सामने से सार-बल से प्रहार करे।
english: Having struck from the rear, he should strike (the enemy), wavering or turned away, from the front with his best troops.

text_flags.why: absolutive ends in -ya; the long ā is a probable typing error (compare unit 7 abhihatya)

words.gloss: the two attacks on the flanks

hindi: इन दोनों से पार्श्वों पर के दोनों प्रहार समझ लेने चाहिए।
english: By these two, the two attacks on the flanks are explained.

hindi: अथवा जिस ओर शत्रु की दूष्य या दुर्बल सेना हो, उस ओर से प्रहार करे।
english: Or, from the side where (the enemy's) treasonable or weak troops are, from that side he should strike.

hindi: सामने की भूमि विषम हो तो पीछे से प्रहार करे।
english: When the ground is uneven in front, he should strike from the rear.
notes: bhūmau (ground) is understood with viṣamāyām.

hindi: पीछे की भूमि विषम हो तो सामने से प्रहार करे।
english: When the ground is uneven at the rear, he should strike from the front.

hindi: एक पार्श्व की भूमि विषम हो तो दूसरी ओर से प्रहार करे।
english: When the ground is uneven on one flank, he should strike from the other side.

words.gloss: with troops of the treasonable, of enemies and of forest tribes

hindi: अथवा दूष्य, अमित्र और अटवी की सेनाओं से पहले शत्रु को लड़ाकर, स्वयं अथका रहकर थके हुए शत्रु पर प्रहार करे।
english: Or, having first made (the enemy) fight with troops of the treasonable, of enemies and of forest tribes, he, himself unwearied, should strike the enemy when wearied.

words.gloss: having an ambush as his resort

hindi: अथवा दूष्य सेना के द्वारा स्वयं भंग दिखाकर, "जीत गए" ऐसा मानकर विश्वस्त हुए शत्रु पर, स्वयं अविश्वस्त रहकर और सत्र का आश्रय लेकर, प्रहार करे।
english: Or, having himself given a (feigned) rout with the treasonable troops, he, himself not over-confident and with an ambush as his resort, should strike (the enemy) who has become confident, thinking "it is won".
notes: sattra here = a concealed position / ambush (listed in unit 24).

words.gloss: made careless by plundering caravans, herds, camps and transport convoys

hindi: सार्थ, पशु-समूह, स्कन्धावार और संवाह को लूटने में प्रमत्त हुए शत्रु पर स्वयं अप्रमत्त रहकर प्रहार करे।
english: He, himself not careless, should strike (the enemy) made careless by plundering caravans, herds, camps and transport convoys.
notes: skandha-āvāra = military camp; saṃvāha = convoy / baggage-train (literal: 'carrying together').

words.gloss: whose best troops are screened by weak troops

hindi: अथवा दुर्बल सेना से अपनी सार-सेना को ढककर, शत्रु के वीरों के बीच घुसकर प्रहार करे।
english: Or, with his best troops screened by weak troops, having penetrated among the enemy's warriors, he should strike.

words.gloss: by the killing of wild beasts

hindi: गौओं को पकड़ने या वन्य पशुओं के वध के बहाने शत्रु के वीरों को खींचकर, सत्र में छिपे हुए रहकर प्रहार करे।
english: Having drawn out the enemy's warriors by a seizure of cattle or by the killing of wild beasts (a hunt), he, hidden in an ambush, should strike.
notes: śvā.pada = śvāpada (wild beast); the edition's dot marks the etymological members. sattrac.channo = sattra + channaḥ with ch doubled after the short vowel.

hindi: रात में आकस्मिक आक्रमण से जगाए रखकर, नींद से थके हुए या सोए हुए शत्रुओं पर दिन में प्रहार करे।
english: Having kept (them) awake at night by a surprise attack, he should strike by day those exhausted with drowsiness or fallen asleep.

words.gloss: with leather sheaths on their feet
a night attack on the sleeping

hindi: अथवा जिनके पैरों पर चमड़े के कोश बँधे हों ऐसे हाथियों से सोए हुए शत्रु पर रात्रि-आक्रमण करे।
english: Or he should deliver an attack on the sleeping (enemy) with elephants that have leather sheaths on their feet.
notes: sapāda-carma-kośaiḥ taken as a bahuvrīhi qualifying hastibhiḥ (feet muffled with leather so as to be silent).

words.gloss: exhausted by being under arms all day

hindi: दिन भर कवच धारण किए रहने से थके हुए शत्रुओं पर दोपहर के बाद प्रहार करे।
english: He should strike in the afternoon those exhausted by being under arms all day.
notes: Edition writes samnāha with m; saṃnāha in words is the same word (orthographic convention, not an error). apara-ahne = aparāhṇe.

words.gloss: with dry-leather bags holding round pebbles
with herds of cattle, buffaloes and camels
whose elephants and horses are untrained

hindi: सूखे चमड़े के गोल कंकड़ भरे थैलों से, अथवा भड़कने वाले गाय, भैंस और ऊँटों के झुंडों से, जिसके हाथी और घोड़े अप्रशिक्षित हैं ऐसे शत्रु को तोड़कर, उसके पीछे हटने पर स्वयं अटूट रहकर प्रहार करे।
english: With dry-leather bags holding round pebbles, or with timid herds of cattle, buffaloes and camels, he, himself unbroken, should strike (the enemy) whose elephants and horses are untrained, (once he is) broken and turned back.
notes: ākośaka taken as 'container, bag' (rattles of pebbles in dry hide used to frighten animals). trasnubhiḥ qualifies yūthaiḥ.

words.gloss: facing the sun and the wind

hindi: अथवा सूर्य और वायु के सम्मुख स्थित सम्पूर्ण शत्रु-सेना पर प्रहार करे।
english: Or he should strike the whole (enemy force) that faces the sun and the wind.

words.gloss: desert, forest, narrow pass, mud, hill, low ground, uneven ground and boats

hindi: मरुभूमि, वन, सँकरा मार्ग, कीचड़, पर्वत, निचली भूमि, विषम भूमि, नावें, गौएँ, शकट-व्यूह, कुहरा और रात्रि — ये सत्र हैं।
english: Desert, forest, a narrow pass, mud, a hill, low ground, uneven ground, boats, cattle, a cart array, fog and night: these are the ambushes.
notes: sattra = a place or means of concealment for a surprise attack. The edition prints śakaṭavyūho without a member mark.

hindi: और पहले कहे गए प्रहार के काल कूट-युद्ध के कारण हैं।
english: And the earlier mentioned times for striking are occasions for deceptive battle.

hindi: किन्तु जिसके देश और काल पहले से निर्दिष्ट हों, वह संग्राम सबसे अधिक धर्म के अनुकूल है।
english: But a battle with place and time specified (in advance) is the most in accord with dharma.

hindi: सेना को एकत्र करके कहे — "मैं तुम्हारे समान ही वेतन पाने वाला हूँ; यह राज्य तुम्हारे साथ मिलकर भोगने योग्य है; मेरे द्वारा निर्देशित तुम लोगों को शत्रु पर प्रहार करना है।"
english: Having assembled the army, he should say: "I receive the same pay (as you); this kingdom is to be enjoyed together with you; the enemy is to be struck by you as instructed by me."

words.gloss: whose sacrificial fees have been fully paid

hindi: वेदों में भी, जिनकी दक्षिणा पूरी दी जा चुकी है ऐसे यज्ञों के अवभृथ-स्नानों में यह सुना जाता है — "तेरी वही गति हो जो शूरों की है।"
english: In the Vedas too it is heard, at the final baths of sacrifices whose fees have been fully paid: "That is your goal, which is that of heroes."

hindi: इस विषय में ये दो श्लोक भी हैं।
english: Here too there are two verses.

words.gloss: by heaps of (gifts to) worthy recipients

words.gram: m. nom. pl., pres. part. pari-√tyaj

hindi: जिन लोकों को स्वर्ग चाहने वाले ब्राह्मण यज्ञों के समूहों से, तप से और पात्रों को दिए दानों के संचय से प्राप्त करते हैं, उनसे भी आगे अच्छे युद्धों में प्राण त्यागने वाले शूर क्षण भर में पहुँच जाते हैं।
english: Those (worlds) which brahmins seeking heaven reach by multitudes of sacrifices, by austerity and by heaps of (gifts to) worthy recipients, even beyond those do heroes pass in a moment, giving up their lives in good battles.
notes: pātra-caya: pātra = 'worthy recipient (of gifts)' or 'vessel'; 'heaps of gifts to worthy recipients' is given. The quotation opened here closes with iti at the end of unit 31. Metre: upajāti (11 syllables a quarter).

words.gloss: with a covering made of darbha grass

hindi: जल से भरा, भली प्रकार संस्कार किया हुआ, दर्भ के आवरण वाला नया शराव — वह उसे न मिले और वह नरक को जाए, जो अपने स्वामी के अन्न के लिए युद्ध न करे।
english: A new earthen dish full of water, well consecrated, with a covering made of darbha grass: may that not be for him, and may he go to hell, who would not fight for the sake of his master's food.
notes: The water-dish with darbha covering is presumably the funeral water-offering made for the dead; the verse denies it to the man who will not fight for the master who feeds him (bhartṛ-piṇḍa = the food/maintenance received from the master). The verse number '|| 31 ||' is printed inside the line before the closing quote; it is kept as tokens. Metre: upajāti.

words.gloss: through the minister and the chaplain
by the excellence of the battle array

hindi: मन्त्री और पुरोहित के द्वारा व्यूह की सम्पत् दिखाकर योद्धाओं को उत्साहित करे।
english: Through the minister and the chaplain he should encourage the fighters by the excellence of the battle array.

words.gloss: by proclaiming (his) omniscience and his association with divinities

hindi: और उसका कार्तान्तिक आदि का वर्ग उसकी सर्वज्ञता और देवताओं के साथ उसके सम्बन्ध का प्रचार करके अपने पक्ष को उत्साहित करे और शत्रु-पक्ष को उद्विग्न करे।
english: And his group of astrologers and the rest should, by proclaiming (his) omniscience and his association with divinities, make his own side exultant and the enemy's side alarmed.
notes: kārtāntika = astrologer (one who reads fate). Edition writes samyoga with m; saṃyoga in words is the same word.

hindi: "कल युद्ध है" ऐसा जानकर उपवास करके वह अपने शस्त्र और वाहन के पास शयन करे।
english: (Thinking) "tomorrow is the battle", he, having kept a fast, should lie down beside his weapons and vehicle.

hindi: और अथर्व-मन्त्रों से हवन करे।
english: And he should make offerings with Atharvan (spells).

hindi: और विजय से युक्त तथा स्वर्ग-सम्बन्धी आशीर्वचन कहलवाए।
english: And he should have benedictions pronounced that are connected with victory and relate to heaven.

hindi: और ब्राह्मणों को अपने आपको समर्पित करे।
english: And he should commend himself to the brahmins.

words.gloss: endowed with valour, skill, noble birth and loyalty

words.gram: n. acc. sg., ppp caus. vi-sam-√vad with a-

hindi: शौर्य, शिल्प, कुलीनता और अनुराग से युक्त, तथा धन और सम्मान के विषय में जिसके साथ कभी विश्वासघात न हुआ हो, ऐसे सैनिकों को सेना का गर्भ बनाए।
english: He should make the core of the army (one) endowed with valour, skill, noble birth and loyalty, and not let down in money and honour.
notes: avisaṃvādita = 'not disappointed (of promised money and honour)'.

words.gloss: of (men who are) fathers, sons and brothers

hindi: पिता, पुत्र और भाइयों से बने सैनिकों की, ध्वजा-रहित, मुण्ड सेना राजा का स्थान है।
english: A bare army without banners, of soldiers who are fathers, sons and brothers, is the king's station.
notes: muṇḍa-anīka = 'shaven (bare) army', i.e. one without distinguishing marks; pitṛ-putra-bhrātṛka = men serving together with their fathers, sons and brothers.

hindi: हाथी या रथ, घोड़ों के अनुगमन के साथ, राजा का वाहन है।
english: An elephant or a chariot, with a following of horses, is the king's vehicle.

hindi: जिस वाहन की उसकी सेना में अधिकता हो, अथवा जिस पर वह प्रशिक्षित हो, उसी पर वह आरूढ़ हो।
english: Whichever (animal) his army mostly consists of, or on whichever he is trained, that he should mount.

text_flags.why: incomplete token; the editors' doubt mark (tad?) follows and the sense requires tat/tad

notes: The e-text prints 't (tad?)': the word is damaged in the edition and 'tad' is the editors' conjecture; the translation follows it.

words.gloss: one bearing the marks of the king
the station of the battle array

hindi: राजा के चिह्नों वाला व्यक्ति व्यूह के अधिष्ठान पर नियुक्त किया जाए।
english: A man bearing the marks of the king is to be posted at the station of the battle array.
notes: rāja-vyañjana = a man disguised as the king.

words.gloss: praise of the caste, corporation, family, actions and conduct

hindi: सूत और मागध शूरों के लिए स्वर्ग और कायरों के लिए स्वर्ग का अभाव, तथा योद्धाओं की जाति, संघ, कुल, कर्म और आचरण की स्तुति का वर्णन करें।
english: Bards and minstrels should describe heaven for the brave and the absence of heaven for cowards, and the praise of the caste, corporation, family, actions and conduct of the fighters.

words.gloss: the success of their own work

hindi: पुरोहित के पुरुष कृत्या और अभिचार की बात कहें; यन्त्रिक, बढ़ई और मुहूर्त-शास्त्री अपने कर्म की सिद्धि और शत्रुओं की असिद्धि की बात कहें।
english: The chaplain's men should speak of witchcraft and sorcery (performed against the enemy); the engineers, carpenters and astrologers (should speak of) the success of their own work and the failure of the enemies'.
notes: kṛtya.abhicāra: kṛtyā (witchcraft) + abhicāra (sorcery); the compound form kṛtya- is regular. 'performed against the enemy' is implied, not stated.

words.gloss: the killing of the commander or a prince
the killing of a chief of the champions
the killing of an elephant or a chariot (warrior)
the killing of a chief of foot-soldiers
what one seizes oneself (is one's own)

hindi: सेनापति धन और सम्मान से सत्कृत सेना को सम्बोधित करे — "राजा का वध एक लाख का, सेनापति या राजकुमार का वध पचास हज़ार का, प्रमुख वीर का वध दस हज़ार का, हाथी या रथ का वध पाँच हज़ार का, घोड़े का वध एक हज़ार का, पैदल-प्रमुख का वध सौ का, एक सिर बीस का; और वेतन का दुगुना होना तथा स्वयं छीनी हुई वस्तु अपनी।"
english: The commander of the army should address the army, well treated with wealth and honour: "The killing of the king is worth a hundred thousand; the killing of the commander or a prince, fifty thousand; the killing of a chief of the champions, ten thousand; the killing of an elephant or a chariot (warrior), five thousand; the killing of a horse(man), a thousand; the killing of a chief of foot-soldiers, a hundred; a head, twenty; and doubling of pay and whatever one seizes oneself."
notes: The sums are rewards (in paṇas, not stated); 'worth' renders the possessive adjectives śata-sāhasra etc. bhoga = pay/enjoyment; svayaṃ-grāha = the right to keep what one captures oneself.

words.gloss: the chiefs of groups of ten

hindi: इनके दस-दस के वर्गों के अधिपति यह जानें।
english: The chiefs of groups of ten should know this about them.
notes: eṣām = of these soldiers, i.e. the chiefs are to keep account of what each man earns.

words.gloss: with surgical instruments, appliances, antidotes, oils and bandages in their hands

words.gram: f. nom. pl., gerundive caus. ud-√hṛṣ

hindi: शस्त्र, यन्त्र, अगद, स्नेह और वस्त्र हाथ में लिए चिकित्सक, तथा अन्न-पान की रक्षा करने वाली और पुरुषों का उत्साह बढ़ाने वाली स्त्रियाँ पीछे की ओर खड़ी रहें।
english: Physicians with surgical instruments, appliances, antidotes, oils and bandages in their hands, and women guarding food and drink and serving to encourage the men, should stand at the rear.
notes: uddharṣaṇīyāḥ is a gerundive form used here in the sense 'meant for encouraging (the men)'; the form is unusual.

words.gloss: with the sun at its back

hindi: अपनी भूमि पर सेना को इस प्रकार व्यूहबद्ध करे कि उसका मुख दक्षिण की ओर न हो, सूर्य उसके पीछे हो और वायु अनुकूल हो।
english: He should array the army on his own ground so that it does not face south, has the sun at its back and the wind favourable.

words.gloss: when arraying on the enemy's ground

hindi: और शत्रु की भूमि पर व्यूह बनाते समय घोड़ों को इधर-उधर चलाएँ।
english: And when arraying on the enemy's ground, they should make the horses move about.

hindi: जहाँ व्यूह के लिए स्थिर रहना और तेज़ी से बढ़ना, दोनों के लिए भूमि अनुपयुक्त हो, वहाँ स्थिर रहने पर भी और तेज़ी से बढ़ने पर भी, दोनों प्रकार से वह हारेगा।
english: Where the ground is unsuitable for the array both for standing firm and for rapid advance, there, whether standing or rushing forward, he would be defeated in both ways.

hindi: विपरीत स्थिति में वह जीतता है, दोनों प्रकार से — स्थिर रहने में भी और तेज़ी से बढ़ने में भी।
english: In the opposite case he wins, in both ways, in standing and in rapid advance.

hindi: भूमि सम है, विषम है या मिश्रित है — यह सामने, दोनों पार्श्वों में और पीछे जान लेना चाहिए।
english: The ground, whether even, uneven or mixed, is to be known in front, on the two flanks and at the rear.

words.gloss: the snake and the loose arrays

hindi: सम भूमि पर दण्ड और मण्डल व्यूह, विषम भूमि पर भोग और असंहत व्यूह, और मिश्रित भूमि पर विषम व्यूह बनाए जाएँ।
english: On even ground, the staff and circle arrays; on uneven ground, the snake and the loose arrays; on mixed ground, irregular arrays.
notes: daṇḍa here = 'staff' (a straight battle array), not 'army'; bhoga = 'snake' (a winding array); asaṃhata = 'non-compact' (detached groups).

hindi: श्रेष्ठ बल वाले शत्रु को तोड़कर सन्धि की याचना करे।
english: Having broken (an enemy) of superior strength, he should sue for peace.

hindi: समान बल वाले के द्वारा याचना किए जाने पर सन्धि कर ले।
english: Asked by one of equal strength, he should make peace.

words.gloss: one who has reached his own ground
one who has given up his life

hindi: हीन शत्रु का पीछा करके उस पर प्रहार करे, किन्तु अपनी भूमि पर पहुँचे हुए या प्राणों का मोह छोड़ चुके शत्रु पर कभी नहीं।
english: He should pursue and strike an inferior (enemy), but never one who has reached his own ground or one who has given up his life (resolved to die).
notes: tyakta-ātman = one who has abandoned (concern for) himself, i.e. desperate.

words.gram: m. gen. sg., pres. part. ātm. ā-√vṛt
m. nom. sg., gerundive √dhṛ with a-

hindi: जो फिर लौटकर आ रहा हो और जीवन से निराश हो चुका हो, उसमें ऐसा वेग उत्पन्न होता है जिसे रोका नहीं जा सकता; इसलिए टूटे हुए शत्रु को पीड़ित न करे।
english: In one who turns back again and has despaired of life there arises an irresistible impetus; therefore one should not press a broken (enemy).
notes: Metre: anuṣṭubh. jīvite (loc.) goes with nirāśasya: 'despairing in respect of life'.
